---
title: Review
description: Every generated file per language, Quick Look, and contact sheets.
---

**Review**, in Ship, lists every generated file per language and device. Click one to open it in
Quick Look; **Show App in Finder** opens the folder. Files that are missing or out of date say how
many there are to generate.

**Contact Sheets** writes one picture per language and device with every generated screenshot,
into `store/generated/sheets/`: the quickest way to look at a whole listing, or to send it to
someone.

```sh
store-shots sheet
```
